body.content: {"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080010.000010\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_10\", \"channel_id\": \"CEMTEAM\"}\nFleet update: Vehicle F-207 in for service today. Using F-210 as backup."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080001.000001\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_01\", \"channel_id\": \"CEMTEAM\"}\nGood morning ops team. Facilities checklist for today is posted in #facilities-daily."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080014.000014\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_14\", \"channel_id\": \"CEMTEAM\"}\nHVAC filter replacement complete for Building A. Next round: Building C on March 10."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080002.000002\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_02\", \"channel_id\": \"CEMTEAM\"}\nLoading dock 3 cleared and ready for the 7 AM shipment. Dock 1 still blocked by the pallet wrapping machine."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080007.000007\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_07\", \"channel_id\": \"CEMTEAM\"}\nPSA: Server room B2 maintenance window Saturday 2-6 AM. UPS bypass test included."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080017.000017\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_17\", \"channel_id\": \"CEMTEAM\"}\nThe roof leak in Building C has been patched. Monitoring for 48 hours before closing the ticket."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080012.000012\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_12\", \"channel_id\": \"CEMTEAM\"}\nParking lot B re-striping scheduled for this weekend. Please park in Lot C."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080021.000021\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_21\", \"channel_id\": \"CEMTEAM\"}\nOOO: I'm out Thursday/Friday. Nina is covering warehouse ops."}
